company_description: Early-stage B2B SaaS — in-app chat assistant for customer-facing product flows. Self-serve signup, testing hosted API. Latency-sensitive, streaming-first UX; currently public cloud only.
notes: Inbound: MQL via blog post about streaming assistants (2026-02-15). Self-serve signup and used free credits to prototype.

Primary workload: low-latency conversational UI embedded in their product and mobile SDK. Typical session ~40-120 tokens per turn, multi-turn context retained client-side.
Performance targets: p95 end-to-end <250ms on web; perceived streaming latency <150ms for first token on good connections; tolerate up to 400ms on cellular but need graceful chunking.
